title: Crook
desc: An Indian man in Australia finds himself amid racial tensions and crime. As he navigates love and morality, he must choose sides in a world where every action comes with a cost.

title: Parichay
desc: Jobless Ravi accepts the daunting task of tutoring five spoiled children who chased away every teacher, but soon wins their trust and falls in love with Rama, the eldest.

title: Krishna
desc: Krishna, an aspiring pilot, is wrongly imprisoned for seven years. After his release, he secretly teams up with a powerful minister to seek justice and exact revenge.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Ghayal Once Again
desc: Four teens accidentally film a murder involving a well-known figure and soon find themselves in danger. Ajay, a brave journalist, steps in to help them expose the killers.

title: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
desc: Sameer and Nargis finally find hope when they adopt their friend's orphaned niece, Nandini. But just as their lives begin to heal, tragedy strikes again when the little girl is kidnapped.

title: Singh Saab The Great
desc: Singh Saab is an honest and responsible tax officer, but the cunning Bhoodev plots against him. To stand up for what is right, Singh uses a clever and unique plan to teach Bhoodev a strong lesson.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Khushboo
desc: Kusum and Brindavan marry as children, but are separated by a misunderstanding. Years later, fate reunites them, and they struggle to mend broken ties, rediscovering love and trust in each other.

title: Saudagar
desc: Once warm friends, Veeru and Rajeshwar grow into bitter enemies. Years later, their long-buried feud resurfaces when their grandchildren fall in love, forcing the rivals to confront the past.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: KA
desc: Abhinaya Vasudev wakes up amnesiac in a high-security interrogation cell, where a mysterious interrogator uses hypnosis to uncover his past and expose a trail of roguish deeds.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: A young woman, duped and sold to a brothel, rises above despair. Using underworld connections, she transforms from pawn to ruler, commanding power in a ruthless world.

title: Aranmanai 4
desc: A man investigates his sister's suspicious death, uncovering dark secrets that spiral into chaos and terror as he learns far more than he ever expected.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder assumes his wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he discovers Pooja is alive, he scrambles to hide both marriages while juggling between them.
